courses.overview: 由微腔色散、非線性振盪與頻梳相干性延伸到不同工法，保留物理關係並重新界定系統邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Extend microresonator dispersion, nonlinear oscillation and comb coherence to related methods while retaining physical relationships and redefining system boundaries.

related.title: 微環波分多工濾波器
related.why: 共用共振、耦合、熱漂移與調諧量測。
related.whyEn: Both use resonance, coupling, drift and tuning measurements.
related.transfer: 共用共振、耦合、熱漂移與調諧量測。
related.transferEn: Both use resonance, coupling, drift and tuning measurements.
related.difference: WDM 環通常在近線性濾波區；微梳刻意利用非線性且要辨識動態狀態。
related.differenceEn: WDM rings usually filter near-linearly; microcombs deliberately exploit nonlinearity and require state identification.
practice: 比較兩課相同 Q 下需額外量的動態證據。
在兩課中各選一個能推翻結論的量測。
標出交接時不能直接沿用的材料參數或控制條件。
practiceEn: Compare additional dynamic evidence needed at equal Q.
Choose one falsifying measurement in each course.
Identify material parameters or control conditions that cannot be transferred unchanged.

related.title: 光子晶片量子光源
related.titleEn: Quantum light sources on photonic chips
related.why: 四波混頻同時連結經典頻梳與自發光子對。
related.whyEn: Four-wave mixing connects classical combs and spontaneous photon pairs.
related.transfer: 四波混頻同時連結經典頻梳與自發光子對。
related.transferEn: Four-wave mixing connects classical combs and spontaneous photon pairs.
related.difference: 高功率經典梳不是量子光源證明；後者需關聯與統計測試。
related.differenceEn: A high-power classical comb does not prove a quantum source; correlations and statistics are needed.
practice: 列相同光譜仍無法判斷的量子指標。
在兩課中各選一個能推翻結論的量測。
標出交接時不能直接沿用的材料參數或控制條件。
practiceEn: List quantum metrics that an identical spectrum cannot establish.

courses.summary: 矽光子頻率梳以微腔色散、非線性振盪與頻梳相干性連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: Silicon-photonic frequency combs links device physics and system validation through microresonator dispersion, nonlinear oscillation and comb coherence. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以微腔色散、非線性振盪與頻梳相干性比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through microresonator dispersion, nonlinear oscillation and comb coherence, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: 微腔色散工程與頻梳實驗
history.text: Nature Communications / research authors 的「微腔色散設計與頻率梳」提供可追溯的發展案例。它支援本課的原理與設計問題；課程算例另行設定，並不冒充該研究的性能。研究事件與地圖的封裝代表據點分開標示，不主張兩者發生在同一地點。
history.textEn: Nature Communications / research authors: Microresonator dispersion engineering and frequency combs provides a traceable development example. It informs the principles and design questions; course calculations use separate assumptions and do not claim that study's performance. The research event and the representative packaging location are distinct and are not claimed to share a site.

history.title: 從單元件指標到可測試系統
history.titleEn: From component metrics to testable systems
history.text: 本課把微腔色散、非線性振盪與頻梳相干性放在材料、介面及封裝的連續證據鏈中。下列原始研究與機構資料呈現不同發展路線；此欄是教學脈絡，並非宣稱此地的發明年表。
history.textEn: This course puts microresonator dispersion, nonlinear oscillation and comb coherence within a continuous evidence chain of materials, interfaces and packaging. The primary studies and institutional records show different development routes; this is learning context, not a claimed invention timeline for this location.
